ValidationRule.description: Validates the selected account must be same as the Invoice Account if Invoice is present
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), NOT(ISBLANK( NSP_Invoice__c )) , NOT (ISBLANK(NSP_Account__c) ), NSP_Account__c != NSP_Invoice__r.blng__Account__c, NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.LockBoxValidations__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Selected Account must be same as Invoice Account.
